display_name: The whole Carbon Pricing Act 2018 (ss 1-79, First to Fifth Schedules) under one top-level goal — what a facility's operator must do and owe for an emissions year — and seven goals: registration, reporting, the tax, payment, assessments and appeals, records, offences
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 06 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition with Act 37 of 2022, in force 1 January 2024). The law is stated for emissions years and events from 2024; earlier ones refuse, the Third Schedule tables answering for every year. Inert (carried as text): powers, procedure and definitions with nothing to compute, listed in cpa-process-offences.l4. Inputs: discretions, prescribed sectors, ICC criteria and limits, and everything else prescribed by regulations. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-06 (tests-independent.l4; expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, in independent-expectations.md); it found that dated rules lacked the vintage gate, fixed; triage in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md and NOTES.md section 8. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: Emissions years and events before 2024 refuse (Act 37 of 2022 rewrote Parts 3 and 5); the Third Schedule tables answer for every year.
forks.F2: s 7(5)(d): Y registers as taxable where the facility was taxable for X or attained the second threshold in the year before the transfer.
forks.F3: s 15(1) working days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays (an input).
forks.F4: s 17(3): credits at the purchase year's price, rounded up; s 17(3B) revisions round down.
forks.F5: s 17(4): 5% the day after the last day; 1% per completed month from 60 days after; the triple cap covers the 1% penalties.
forks.F6: s 4: a tie at the greatest authority refuses.
forks.F7: s 8(1)(a)(ii): (C) prevails where (A) could also apply.
